Part 1 (Interview)
[0:22] Examiner: Good afternoon. My name is Jenny Cook and this  is my colleague Jenny Tennant. And your names are?
[0:26] Florine: My name is Florine Maria: And my name is Maria.
[0:32] Examiner: Can I have your mark sheets please? Florine: Yes, of course.
[0:36] Examiner: Thank you.
[0:39] Examiner: Where are you from, Florine?
[0:41] Florine: I'm from Holland, from The Netherlands.
[0:44] Examiner: And you Maria? Maria: I'm from Argentina.
[0:51] Examiner: Well first we'd like to know something about you. Florine tell us about a film you really like.
[0:54] Florine: I really like the movie Titanic.
[1:09] I actually have seen it last night, and I like it because it's the story actually happens, and I like the love relate love relationship between the two main characters.
[1:14] Examiner: Maria are you going to do anything special this weekend?
[1:22] Maria: Yes, this weekend I'm going with my best friends to the cinema to see a comedy film.
[1:28] Examiner: Mm-hmm. And Florine, how much television do you watch in a week?
[1:38] Florine: Actually quite a lot. My mum doesn't always really like it, but I love watch kind of different things.
[1:48] I watch the regular news and also just like the lazy entertainment programs and also I watch a lot of movies. So yeah quite a lot actually.
[1:51] Examiner: Maria, do you ever listen to the radio?
[1:59] Maria: Not often, but some Sundays I switch on the radio to listen music.
[2:03] Examiner: Thank you.

Part 2 (Long turn)
[2:07] Examiner: In this part of the test I'm going to give each of you two photographs.
[2:16] I'd like you to talk about your photographs on your own for about a minute and also to answer a question about your partner's photographs.
[2:22] Florine it's your turn first. Here are your photographs.
[2:27] They show people who are helping other people in different situations.
[2:36] I'd like you to compare the photographs and say how important it is to help people in these situations. All right?
[2:45] Florine: Yeah. I think in the first picture it's someone helping a soccer player because he's obviously hurt.
[2:57] And in the second photo at the police officer is helping I think it must be a tourist because there is a map in the photo.
[3:10] And I think it's really important to help people in those situations because they're both in... they both needed help.
[3:24] And in the first picture the person is probably in pain because mostly when you play sports you can get injuries.
[3:38] And in the second photo I think it's also very important that the police officer is willing to help the tourist because it's just I think police officers are there because they have to serve the people.
[3:45] Examiner: Thank you. Maria do you find it easy to ask for help when you have a problem?
[3:58] Maria: It depends what problem I have because sometimes when you are in different places you are shy so you don't ask for help.
[4:02] Examiner: Thank you. Can I have the booklet please?
[4:07] Florine: Yes, of course.
[4:10] Examiner: Now Maria, here are your photographs.
[4:14] They show people spending time in different gardens.
[4:19] I'd like you to compare the photographs and say what you think
[4:22] the people are enjoying about spending time in these gardens.
[4:32] Maria: OK, I can see in the first picture a woman doing gardening, in maybe his house.
[4:49] And on the second one I can see in a beautiful park, maybe near London, and we are spending time with his family.
[5:03] and well the first one, the girl is planting a nice plant.
[5:21] And I think both are enjoying a lot these hobbies.
[5:27] Examiner: Thank You. Florine, which garden would you prefer  to spend time in?
[5:33] Florine: I think I would prefer the garden in the first picture because I think it's her own garden
[5:42] and I like working in a garden with my mom and dad, so I think I would enjoy spending time own garden most. Yeah.
[5:54] Examiner: Thank you. Can I have the booklet please?

Part 3 (Collaborative task)
[5:59] Examiner: Now I'd like you to talk about something together for about two minutes.
[6:05] I'd like you to imagine that a town wants more  tourists to visit.
[6:11] Here are some ideas they're thinking about and a question for you to discuss.
[6:31] First, you have some time to look at the task.
[6:37] Examiner: Now, talk to each other about why these ideas would  attract more tourists to the town.
[6:44] Florine: Well I think all the ideas on the on the booklet are quite good actually.
[6:55] I think holiday flats will attract more tourists because there is just more space for the tourists to live in while they're on holiday.
[6:57] And what do you think about that?
[7:05] Maria: Well I agree with you, but maybe providing parks is much better.
[7:08] Florine: Why do you think that actually?
[7:13] Maria: Because I think to spend time in parks are good with the family.
[7:22] Florine: Yeah I think you can have a lot of fun in parks though. This having a nice picnic with your friends or stuff. Yeah that would be nice.
[7:31] With more shops, yeah that I think it would be nice because I think a lot of people, mostly women, like shopping.
[7:38] And I think having a lot of shops here in town would be nice for the shopaholics.
[7:47] Maria: Yes, or I don't know maybe the tourists and like to spend more time in parks than go shopping, no?
[7:58] Florine: Maybe if you are a kind of a nature person, if you like nature a lot, then parks are probably much better than a lot of shops.
[8:06] Florine: Putting up security cameras. Yeah, I think that's a really good idea because then the town is safe and tourists will feel safe.
[8:18] Maria: Yes, with this, with the cameras are good idea because and the people are more safe than without cameras.
[8:21] Of the people that want to stole.
[8:29] Florine: Yeah. Building a large... No I don't think building a large nightclub is really a good idea to attract tourists. I don't know.
[8:34] Maria: It depends the age of the tourists, no?
[8:45] Florine: Yeah definitely but I don't think it will attract a lot of tourists because of one club. I think it's a combination of several things that attract tourists.
[8:52] Examiner: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which idea would be best for the town.
[8:58] Florine: OK. So what do you think is the best idea for the town to do?
[9:02] Maria: I think building holiday flats mainly.
[9:04] Florine: Yes. Why do you think that?
[9:12] Maria: Mmm because all the tourists like to have flats to stay.
[9:26] Florine: Yeah. Maybe the parks are just a better idea to provide because they... they're really nice to just have a walk in and enjoy the nature with your friends and family.
[9:32] Maria: Yes. So, if you like, providing parks I think it's a good idea.
[9:34] Florine: Yeah I do think that's a good here idea.
[9:39] Yeah, and but also the holiday flats I think it's a good idea because um
[9:47] you have to... you have to have space for the tourists to live in so if there's no space there probably won't be a lot of tourists.
[9:49] Maria: Mm-hmm. Florine: Yeah.

Part 4 (Discussion)
[9:56] Examiner: Thank you. Can I have the booklet please? Thank you.
[10:01] Examiner: Florine, do you think you have to spend a lot of money to have a good holiday?
[10:09] Florine: I don't think you have to spend a lot of money because I think you can also have a...
[10:16] Well, you can also have a good holiday when you're with just your friends or people you like to spend time with.
[10:21] And I don't think that should be in a nice fancy hotel or something where you have to spend a lot of money.
[10:25] Just you have to be with people you like and enjoy being with.
[10:27] Maria: What do you think Maria?
[10:45] Maria: Well it depends which place you want to go, because maybe if you want to go to a nice an island you I think you are going to spend a lot of money then if you go to a campsite.
[10:48] Examiner: Mm-hmm Maria: with friends Examiner: Mmm-hmm
[10:57] Examiner: Maria, some people say we travel too much these days and shouldn't go on so many holidays. What do you think?
[11:06] Maria: Yes I think now nowadays a lot of people travel more than few years ago.
[11:17] Because I think the the world is increasing, so the people likes to travel.
[11:19] Examiner: Do you agree, Florine?
[11:28] Florine: I think we travel a lot these days but I think that's also because everybody has got a lot more money to spend.
[11:34] So I think they spend it on traveling because they want to see a lot of the world.
[11:42] Examiner: Florine, do you think people have enough time for holidays these days?
[11:54] Florine: Hmm no I don't think so. I think if you're in school like I am you've got a lot of long breaks especially the summer break is a long break.
[12:05] But I think when you're done with school and you have to start your professional life then there's there isn't a lot of time for holidays. So, yeah.
[12:08] Examiner: Do you Maria? Maria: Yes I agree with Florine.
[12:18] Mmm but some people works not a lot so maybe can take more holidays than other people.
[12:22] Examiner: Why do you think people like to go away on holiday?
[12:32] Florine: Well I think because they would like to see a lot of different parts of the world so they can just like develop their knowledge of it.
[12:39] Maria: Yes, and it's a good idea to spend time doing this and traveling around the world.
[12:42] Florine: Yeah I think it's a good idea as well.
[12:49] Examiner: What do you think the biggest advantage of living in a place where there are a lot of tourists?
[12:54] Florine: I actually don't really think that there are a lot of advantages. Do you think that?
[13:08] Maria: No because maybe the city or the town is going to be so crowd, so you can do a lot of activities because other places are full.
[13:17] Florine: Yeah. I think it's mostly the only big advantage is that you get a lot of money from the tourists so it's good for the local economy.
[13:20] Maria: The economy. Florine: Yeah.
[13:28] Florine: I don't think for the city itself it's big advantage to have a lot of foreign people. So, yeah.
[13:34] Examiner: And what can people do to have a good holiday in Holland?
[13:42] Florine: I think they should go to Amsterdam because it's the main city of the Netherlands.
[13:53] And I think they can spend a lot of time in the nature we have got, mostly in the north of the Netherlands. It's pretty, it's very pretty.
[14:02] And I think yeah, most cities are pretty nice to visit because everyone is really nice yeah.
[14:05] And they're willing to help you you need something.
[14:07] Examiner: And in Argentina?
[14:16] Maria: When in Argentina, if you like to do some nature activities you can go to the Iguazú Falls.
[14:32] And then in the south you can do sports in the snow such as skiing, snower or walking with friends.
Examiner: Thank you. That is the end of the test. Florine: OK. Thank you very much. Maria: Thank you.
